records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Harbor Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Glad to have Harbor Logistics on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Harbor Logistics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 (2026-07-27) but no key milestone, no invites, zero tickets, and no reply to two outreach emails (email:dfd3e422, email:55bcf971) over 6 days — silent, single-user Starter account suggests low self-driven momentum in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Following up on my last note — you've got a project created, which is the main hurdle. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding your real tasks to that project is usually what makes everything else click.

If it would help to have a second pair of eyes on it, I'm happy to do a short call this week and walk through it with you.

Best,
Nadia
